rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts remain mandatory before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task/takeover while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_PRIMARY: EA Composite DTM 1m remains the primary bare-earth terrain source.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM2M_SECONDARY: EA Composite DTM 2m is a secondary resolution cross-check and remains derived/resampled.
rule_descriptions.EA_COMPOSITE_NEWEST_BEST: Composite newest/best-resolution selection is a merge policy, not parcel survey identity.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Exact contributing survey remains unknown until metadata-index feature matching succeeds.
rule_descriptions.EA_TIMESTAMPED_DTM: Time-stamped DTM provides survey-specific dates/resolution/transform lineage.
rule_descriptions.EA_TIMESTAMPED_DSM_EXCLUDE: DSM includes surface objects and is excluded from primary bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.EA_POINT_CLOUD_LINEAGE: Point cloud supports derivation/lineage but a matching historic point cloud may be absent.
rule_descriptions.EA_FIRST_RETURN_DSM_EXCLUDE: First-return DSM includes objects and feathered overlaps and is excluded from DTM extrema.
rule_descriptions.EA_NLP_SURVEY_ID: National LIDAR Programme survey id/phase must come from metadata, not nearest-block inference.
rule_descriptions.EA_OSGRID_ODN: EA raster position/elevation semantics remain OS Grid plus Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
rule_descriptions.EA_TRANSFORM_SURVEY_SPECIFIC: Survey-period transformation/geoid metadata must remain explicit.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_GENERAL_BOUNDARY: Most title plans show general rather than exact legal boundaries.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_NO_STANDARD_TOLERANCE: No standard tolerance/measurement/ratio maps a title-plan general boundary to the legal line.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_TITLE_PLAN_GENERAL_EXTENT: Title plan identifies general extent and must be read with register/filed documents.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_DETERMINED_BOUNDARY: Exact legal-boundary claims require determined-boundary evidence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_HORIZONTAL_NOT_VERTICAL: Legal/mapping boundary uncertainty must not be converted into vertical terrain error.
rule_descriptions.NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: Unknown/missing survey lineage must never be converted to zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing measured 1m/2m values remain unchanged during research QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% remains repository workflow confidence, not universal statistical coverage.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until canonical recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while F-host receipts are missing.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo overlay visibility is not live port-8012 browser acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten under concurrent branch activity.
